title: Guarantee Slip Reduction on Readjustment Parts — Alignment Services & Plans
content:
On an Alignment Services & Plans readjustment, a guarantee slip reduction takes a percentage of the parts amount off the parts charge, set by the calendar days from the corrected alignment's work-order date to the readjustment's date.

| Calendar days from the corrected alignment to the readjustment | Reduction, as a percentage of the parts amount |
|---|---|
| no more than 60 | 20% |
| more than 60 but no more than 120 | 10% |
| more than 120 | 0% |

The reduction is worked out on its own, as a percentage of the parts amount, and taken off the parts charge, which is rounded to the nearest cent and never falls below 0.00.

**Boundaries (hypothetical, parts amount 50.00):** 60 days → 10.00 taken off; 61 days → 5.00; 120 days → 5.00; 121 days → nothing.
